name: Palmetto Masters
description: Palmetto Masters (PALM) is a US Masters Swimming club in the Charleston area, with coached practices in Mt. Pleasant and North Charleston, South Carolina. Practices for all levels.

hero.sub: Palmetto Masters — Mt. Pleasant & North Charleston, South Carolina
hero.tagline: A US Masters Swimming club for the Charleston area

scheduleNote: USMS membership (or a 30-day trial membership) is required to swim with the team. Contact the club for current practice times.
